rv.q: It’s refreshing to see such creativity on the stage, lovingly and vividly produced, seeking to break boundaries in more ways than one.
Still, this is an enjoyable and relevant play, despite its flippant jokiness, and with its imperfections.
Still, best of intentions aside, this one just wasn’t for me.

cn.t: Critics find "Wives" features delightful performances and dazzling design in its feminist reimagining of history, though the time-hopping comedy's script doesn't fully match the strength of its execution.
